description: Read one Actions variable by name. Pass owner + repo for a repository variable, owner + repo + environment for an environment variable, or org for an organisation variable (organisation variables need an admin-scoped token). Not found is an error. Returns {name, value, createdAt, updatedAt}.

name.description: Variable name: letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit or GITHUB_ (stored upper-case)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug (omit when passing org)

name: gluecron_get_variable
